primitives.note: Transform swaps between Cannon Stance (ranged, Q=Shock Blast, W=Hyper Charge) and Hammer Stance (melee, Q=To the Skies!, W=Lightning Field, E=Thundering Blow/Acceleration Gate), each granting a distinct empowered next-basic-attack effect.

Hyper Charge (Cannon W) arms Jayce's next 3 basic attacks with bonus modified physical damage; Transform (R) arms Jayce's next basic attack with bonus magic damage (Hammer Stance) or an armor/MR shred (Cannon Stance), consumed on next hit.
Hyper Charge resets Jayce's basic attack timer on cast.
Hyper Charge grants 360% bonus attack speed for its duration; Hammer Stance grants bonus armor and magic resist for the duration Jayce stays in that stance (relevant to the survival fight).
Lightning Field (Hammer W) deals magic damage every second for 4 seconds to enemies around Jayce.
Cannon Stance's empowered attack reduces the target's armor and magic resistance for 5 seconds, increasing subsequent damage taken.
Thundering Blow (Hammer E) deals magic damage scaling off the target's maximum health (capped vs. monsters, irrelevant to a champion dummy).
Shock Blast's damage is multiplied 1.4x if the bolt passes through Jayce's own Acceleration Gate (E) — a two-ability interaction, not a self-contained recast.
Shock Blast is an AoE projectile that detonates on hit or at max range; whether/how reliably it threads Acceleration Gate for the supercharge is a geometry assumption the dummy fight has to make.
Mana costs on Shock Blast/To the Skies!, Lightning Field/Hyper Charge, and Thundering Blow can gate how often each is cast within 15s absent Lightning Field's on-hit mana restore.
To the Skies!/Shock Blast deal damage on arrival/detonation on cooldown; Thundering Blow deals damage at the end of its cast time on cooldown.

needsBespoke.why: The stance swap, empowered attacks, DoT zone, resist shred, %max-health damage, and the Shock Blast/Acceleration Gate supercharge interaction are all expressible with existing primitives (form-or-stance, empowered-attack, dot, target-debuff, conditional-damage, recast-or-multipart, positional-assumption).

Cast Shock Blast through the gate for the supercharged damage instance.
Basic-attack to consume the Cannon Stance empowered attack (armor/MR shred) on the target.

questions: Does Jayce start the fight in Hammer Stance or Cannon Stance by default, and can the simulator choose freely?

Is frequent stance-swapping (to fish for Transform's on-hit bonus and the 30 movement-speed/ghost proc) actually worth the lost uptime versus just staying in Cannon Stance and auto-attacking/Shock Blasting for the whole fight?

Given Acceleration Gate only lasts 4s and Shock Blast's own cooldown may be as low as 8s (see unsettled cooldown question), how many of the ~15s fight's Shock Blasts can realistically be supercharged?
Does Thundering Blow's 0.4s post-cast lockout on Q/Shock Blast meaningfully change optimal cast order, or is it negligible next to Q's own cooldown?

Should Lightning Field (Hammer W, a stationary DoT zone) be treated as worth casting during a brief Hammer-Stance detour, or does its short duration make swapping into Hammer purely for E/Q/W actually lose net DPS versus staying ranged?
